name: computable-systems-engineering
description: AI-assisted systems design with connected models, clear diagrams, and checks you can inspect.

interface.longDescription: Explore how people, software, equipment, and services work together. Eleven focused skills connect concepts, architecture, scenarios, measures and evidence. Deterministic checks cover declared calculations, flows, queues, failures, observations, changes and artifact freshness. Consequential decisions stay with you.
defaultPrompt: Help me explore this system idea. Identify functions, people, alternatives, and the evidence we still need.
Walk through normal operation and recovery with the operational-scenarios skill.
Check the selected connected system against retained scope and generate a source-linked current-system view.
